1.1: Hachittim vehazzunin enan kilayim ze vaze. hasseorim veshibbolet shual, hakkussemin vehashshifon, happol vehassappir, happurkedan vehattofeach, ufol hallavan vehashsheuim, enam kilayim ze vaze:
1.2: Hakkishshut vehammelaffon, enam kilayim ze vaze. rabbi yehuda omer, kilayim. chazeret vachazeret gallim, ulshin veulshe sade, kereshim uchereshe sade, kusbar vechusbar sade, chardal vechardal mitzri, udelaat hammitzri veharmutza, ufol mitzri vehecharuv, enam kilayim ze vaze:
1.3: Hallefet vehannafutz, vehakkeruv vehatterovtor, hatteradim vehalleunim, enam kilayim ze vaze. hosif rabbi akiva, hashshum vehashshumanit, habbatzal vehabbetzaltzul, vehatturmos vehappelaslos, enan kilayim ze vaze:
1.4: Uvailan, haagasim vehakkerustumelin, vehapperishim vehauzradim, enam kilayim ze vaze. hattappuach vehachazrad, happarsekim vehashshekedin, vehashshizzafin veharimin, af al pi sheddomin ze laze, kilayim ze vaze:
1.5: Hatztzenon vehannafutz, hachardal vehallafsan, udelaat yevanit im hammitzrit veharmutza, af al pi sheddomin ze laze, kilayim ze vaze:
1.6: Hazzeev vehakkelev, kelev hakkufri vehashshual, haizzim vehatztzevaim, hayyeelim veharchelim, hassus vehappered, happered vehachamor, hachamor vehearod, af al pi sheddomin ze laze, kilayim ze vaze:
1.7: En meviin ilan beilan, yarak beyarak, velo ilan beyarak, velo yarak beilan. rabbi yehuda mattir yarak beilan:
1.8: En notin yerakot betoch saddan shel shikma. en markivin pegam al gabbe kidda levana, mippene shehu yarak beilan. en notin yichur shel teena letoch hachatzuv, sheyyehe mekero. en tochavin zemora shel gefen letoch haavattiach, shettehe zoreket memeha letocho, mippene shehu ilan beyarak. en notnin zera delaat letoch hachallamit, shettehe meshammarto, mippene shehu yarak beyarak:
1.9: Hattomen lefet utzenonot tachat haggefen, im hayu miktzat alav megullin, eno choshesh lo mishshum kilayim, velo mishshum sheviit, velo mishshum maasrot, venittalim beshabbat. hazzorea chitta useora keachat, hare ze chilayim. rabbi yehuda omer, eno kilayim, ad sheyyehu shene chittim useora, o chitta ushete seorim, o chitta useora vechussamet:

2.1: Kol sea sheyyesh bo rova mimmin acher, yemaet. rabbi yose omer, yavor. ben mimmin echad ben mishshene minin. rabbi shimon omer, lo amru ella mimmin echad. vachachamim omrim, kol shehu chilayim bassea mitztaref lerova:
2.2: Bamme devarim amurim. tevua vitvua vekitnit bekitnit, tevua vekitnit vekitnit bitvua. beemet amru, zerone ginna sheenan neechalin, mitztarfin echad meesrim vearba benofel levet sea. rabbi shimon omer, keshem sheamru lehachemir kach amru lehakel, happishtan battevua mitztarefet echad meesrim vearba benofel levet sea:
2.3: Hayta sadehu zerua chittim venimlach lezarah seorim, yamtin lah ad shettatlia, veyofach, veachar kach yizra. im tzimmecha, lo yomar ezra veachar kach ofach, ella hofech veachar kach zorea. kamma yehe choresh, ketalme harvia. abba shaul omer, kede shello yeshayyer rova levet sea:
2.4: Zerua venimlach lenatah, lo yomar etta veachar kach ofach, ella hofech veachar kach notea. netua venimlach lezarah, lo yomar ezra veachar kach asharesh, ella mesharesh veachar kach zorea. im ratza, gomem ad pachot mittefach, zorea, veachar kach mesharesh:
2.5: Hayta sadehu zerua kanbos o luf, lo yehe zorea uva al gabbehem, sheenan osin ella lishlosha shanim. tevua sheala vah sefiche istis, vechen mekom haggeranot shealu vahen minin harebe, vechen tiltan sheheela mine tzemachim, en mechayyevin oto lenakkesh. im nikkesh o chissach, omrim lo, akor et hakkol chutz mimmin echad:
2.6: Harotze laasot sadehu meshar meshar mikkol min, bet shammay omrim, shelosha telamim shel patiach. uvet hillel omrim, melo haol hashsharoni. ukerovin divre ellu lihyot kedivre ellu:
2.7: Haya rosh tor chittim nichnas betoch shel seorim, muttar, mippene shehu nire kesof sadehu. shello chittim veshel chavero min acher, muttar lismoch lo meoto hammin. shello chittim veshel chavero chittim, muttar lismoch lo telem shel pishtan, velo telem shel min acher. rabbi shimon omer, echad zera pishtan veechad kol hamminin. rabbi yose omer, af beemtza sadehu muttar livdok betelem shel pishtan:
2.8: En somchin lisde tevua chardal vecharia, aval somchin lisde yerakot chardal vecharia. vesomech levur, ulenir, ulegafa, ulederech, ulegader gavoah asara tefachim, ulecharitz shehu amok asara verachav arbaa, uleilan shehu mesech al haaretz, ulesela gavoah asara verachav arbaa:
2.9: Harotze laasot sadehu karachat karachat mikkol min, ose esrim vearba karachot levet sea, mikkarachat levet rova, vezorea betochah kol min sheyyirtze. hayta karachat achat o shetayim, zoram chardal. shalosh, lo yizra chardal, mippene shehi niret kisde chardal, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, tesha karachot muttarot, eser asurot. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, afillu chol sadehu bet kor, lo yaase vetochah chutz mikkarachat achat:
2.10: Kol shehu vetoch bet rova, ole vemiddat bet rova. achilat haggefen vehakkever vehassela, olin bemiddat bet rova. tevua vitvua, bet rova. yarak beyarak, shishsha tefachim. tevua veyarak, yarak bitvua, bet rova. rabbi eliezer omer, yarak bitvua, shishsha tefachim:
2.11: Tevua nota al gabbe tevua, veyarak al gabbe yarak, tevua al gabbe yarak, yarak al gabbe tevua, hakkol muttar, chutz middelaat yevanit. rabbi meir omer, af hakkishshut ufol hammitzri, veroe ani et divrehen middevaray:

3.1: Aruga shehi shishsha tefachim al shishsha tefachim, zorim betochah chamishsha zeronim, arbaa bearba ruchot haaruga, veechad baemtza. haya lah gevul gavoah tefach, zorin betochah shelosha asar, shelosha al kol gevul ugevul, veechad baemtza. lo yitta rosh hallefet betoch haggevul, mippene shehu memalehu. rabbi yehuda omer, shishsha baemtza:
3.2: Kol min zeraim en zorim baaruga, vechol min yerakot zorin baaruga. chardal vaafunim hashshufin, min zeraim. afunim haggamlanim, min yarak. gevul shehaya gavoah tefach venitmaet, kasher, shehaya chasher mittechillato. hattelem veammat hammayim shehem amukkim tefach, zorim letochan shelosha zeronin, echad mikkan, veechad mikkan, veechad baemtza:
3.3: Haya rosh tor yarak nichnas letoch sede yarak acher, muttar, mippene shehu nire kesof sadehu. hayta sadehu zarua yarak, vehu mevakkesh litta betocho shura shel yarak acher, rabbi yishmael omer, ad sheyyehe hattelem mefullash merosh hassade vead rosho. rabbi akiva omer, orech shishsha tefachim verochav meloo. rabbi yehuda omer, rochav kimlo rochav happarsa:
3.4: Hannotea shete shurot shel kishshuin, shete shurot shel deluim, shete shurot shel pol hammitzri, muttar. shura shel kishshuim, shura shel deluim, shura shel pol hammitzri, asur. shura shel kishshuim, shura shel deluim, shura shel pol hammitzri, veshura shel kishshuim, rabbi eliezer mattir, vachachamim osrin:
3.5: Notea adam kishshut udelaat letoch gumma achat, uvilvad shettehe zo nota letzad ze, vezo nota letzad ze, venote sear shel zo lechan, vesear shel zo lechan. shekkol ma sheasru chachamim, lo gazru ella mippene marit haayin:
3.6: Hayta sadehu zarua vetzalim, umevakkesh litta betochah shurot shel deluim, rabbi yishmael omer, oker shete shurot venotea shura achat, umanniach kamat betzalim bimkom shete shurot, veoker shete shurot venotea shura echat. rabbi akiva omer, oker shete shurot venotea shete shurot, umanniach kamat betzalim bimkom shete shurot, veoker shete shurot venotea shete shurot. vachachamim omrim, im en ben shura lachavertah shetem esre amma, lo yekayyem et hazzera shel bentayim:
3.7: Delaat beyarak, keyarak. uvitvua, notnin lah bet rova. hayta sadehu zerua tevua, uvikkesh litta letochah shura shel deluin, notnin lah laavodatah shishsha tefachim. veim higdila, yaakor millefaneha. rabbi yose omer, notnin lah avodatah arba ammot. amru lo, hatachmir zo min haggafen. amar lahen, matzinu shezzo chamura min haggefen, shellegefen yechidit notnin lah avodatah shishsha tefachim, velidlaat yechidit notnin lah bet rova. rabbi meir omer mishshum rabbi yishmael, kol shelosha deluin levet sea, lo yavi zera letoch bet sea. rabbi yose ben hachotef efrati amar mishshum rabbi yishmael, kol shelosha deluin levet kor, lo yavi zera letoch bet kor:

4.1: Karachat hakkerem, bet shammay omrim, esrim vearba ammot. uvet hillel omrim shesh esre amma. mechol hakkerem, bet shammay omrim, shesh esre amma. uvet hillel omrim shetem esre amma. veezo hi karachat hakkerem. kerem shecharav meemtzao. im en sham shesh esre amma, lo yavi zera lesham. hayu sham shesh esre amma, notnin lah avodatah, vezorea et hammotar:
4.2: Eze hu mechol hakkerem. ben kerem laggader. im en sham shetem esre amma, lo yavi zera lesham. hayu sham shetem esre amma, notnin lo avodato vezorea et hammotar:
4.3: Rabbi yehuda omer, en ze ella geder hakkerem. veeze hu mechol hakkerem. ben shene hakkeramim. eze hu gader, shehu gavoah asara tefachim. vecharitz, shehu amok asara verachav arbaa:
4.4: Mechitztzat hakkanim, im en ben kane lachavero shelosha tefachim, kede sheyyikkanes haggedi, hare zo chimchitztza. vegader shennifratz, ad eser ammot hare hu chefetach, yater mikken, keneged happirtza asur. nifretzu vo feratzot harebe, im haomed merubbe al happarutz, muttar, veim happarutz merubbe al haomed, keneged happirtza asur:
4.5: Hannotea shura shel chamesh gefanim, bet shammay omrim, kerem. uvet hillel omrim, eno cherem, ad sheyyehu sham shete shurot. lefichach, hazzorea arba ammot shebbakkerem, bet shammay omrim, kiddesh shura achat. uvet hillel omrim, kiddesh shete shurot:
4.6: Hannotea shetayim keneged shetayim, veachat yotza zanav, hare ze cherem. shetayim keneged shetayim veachat bentayim, o shetayim keneged shetayim veachat baemtza, eno cherem, ad sheyyehu shetayim keneged shetayim veachat yotza zanav:
4.7: Hannotea shura achat betoch shello, veshura achat betoch shel chavero, vederech hayyachid vederech harabbim baemtza, vegader shehu namuch measara tefachim, hare ellu mitztarfot. gavoah measara tefachim, enan mitztarfot. rabbi yehuda omer, im ersan milmala, hare ellu mitztarfot:
4.8: Hannotea shete shurot, im en benehen shemone ammot, lo yavi zera lesham. hayu shalosh, im en ben shura lachavertah shesh esre amma, lo yavi zera lesham. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer mishshum chanina ven chachinay, afillu charva haemtzait veen ben shura lachavertah shesh esre amma, lo yavi zera lesham, sheillu mittechilla netaan hare ze muttar bishmone ammot:
4.9: Hannotea et karmo al shesh esre amma shesh esre amma, muttar lehavi zera lesham. amar rabbi yehuda, maase vetzalmon, beechad shennata et karmo al shesh esre shesh esre amma, vehaya hofech sear shete shurot letzad echad vezorea et hannir, uveshana acheret haya hofech et hassear lemakom acher vezorea et habbur, uva maase lifne chachamim, vehittiru. rabbi meir verabbi shimon omrim, af hannotea et karmo al shemone shemone ammot, muttar:

5.1: Kerem shecharav, im yesh bo lelakket eser gefanim levet sea, unetuot kehilchatan, hare ze nikra kerem dal. kerem shehu natua irbuveya, im yesh bo lechavven shetayim neged shalosh, hare ze cherem. veim lav, eno cherem. rabbi meir omer, hoil vehu nire chetavnit hakkeramim, hare ze charem:
5.2: Kerem shehu natua al pachot pachot mearba ammot, rabbi shimon omer, eno cherem. vachachamim omrim, kerem, veroin et haemtzaiyyot keillu enan:
5.3: Charitz shehu over bakkerem, amok asara verachav arbaa, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, im haya mefullash merosh hakkerem vead sofo, hare ze nire keven shene cheramim, vezorim betocho. veim lav, hare hu chegat. vehaggat shebbecherem amukka asara urechava arbaa, rabbi eliezer omer, zorim betochah, vachachamim osrim. shomera shebbakkerem, gevoha asara urechava arbaa, zorin betochah. veim haya sear kotesh, asur:
5.4: Gefen shehi netua vegat o veneka, notnin lah avodatah, vezorea et hammotar. rabbi yose omer, im en sham arba ammot, lo yavi zera lesham. vehabbayit shebbakkerem, zorin betocho:
5.5: Hannotea yarak bakkerem o mekayyem, hare ze mekaddesh arbaim vachamishsha gefanim. ematay, bizman shehayu netuot al arba arba, o al chamesh chamesh. hayu netuot al shesh shesh, o al sheva sheva, hare ze mekaddesh shesh esre amma lechol ruach, agullot velo merubbaot:
5.6: Haroe yarak bakkerem, veamar kesheaggia lo alakketennu, muttar. kesheechezor alakketennu, im hosif bematayim, asur:
5.7: Haya over bakkerem venaflu mimmennu zeraim, o sheyyatzu im hazzevalim o im hammayim, hazzorea vesiarattu haruach laachorav, muttar. siarattu haruach lefanav, rabbi akiva omer, im asavim, yofach. veim aviv, yenappetz. veim hevia dagan, tiddalek:
5.8: Hamekayyem kotzim bakkerem, rabbi eliezer omer, kiddesh. vachachamim omrim, lo kiddesh ella davar shekkamohu mekayyemin. hairus vehakkissom veshoshannat hammelech vechol mine zeraim, enan kilayim bakkarem. hakkanbos, rabbi tarfon omer, eno chilayim, vachachamim omrim, kilayim. vehakkinras, kilayim bakkarem:

6.1: Ezehu aris, hannote shura shel chamesh gefanim betzad haggader shehu gavoah asara tefachim, o vetzad charitz shehu amok asara tefachim verachav arbaa, notnin lo avodato arba ammot. bet shammay omrim, moddin arba ammot meikkar haggefanim lassade. uvet hillel omrim, min haggader lassade. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, toim kol haomrim ken, ella im yesh sham arba ammot meikkar gefanim velaggader, notnin lo et avodato, vezorea et hammotar. vechamma hi avodat haggefen. shishsha tefachim lechol ruach. rabbi akiva omer, shelosha:
6.2: Aris shehu yotze min hammadrega, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, im omed baaretz uvotzer et kullo, hare ze oser arba ammot bassade, veim lav, eno oser ella chenegdo. rabbi eliezer omer, af hannotea achat baaretz veachat bammadrega, im gavoah min haaretz asara tefachim, enah mitztarefet immah, veim lav, hare zo mitztarefet immah:
6.3: Hammadle et haggefen al miktzat appifyarot, lo yavi zera el tachat hammotar. im hevi, lo kiddesh. veim hillech hechadash, asur. vechen hammadle al miktzat ilan serak:
6.4: Hammadle et haggefen al miktzat ilan maachol, muttar lehavi zera el tachat hammotar. veim hillech hechadash, yachazirennu. maase shehalach rabbi yehoshua etzel rabbi yishmael lichfar aziz, veherahu gefen mudle al miktzat teena. amar lo, ma ani lehavi zera el tachat hammotar. amar lo, muttar. veheelahu mishsham levet hammagniyya, veherahu gefen shehi muddele al miktzat hakkora, vesaddan shel shikma, uvo korot harebe. amar lo, tachat hakkora zo asur, vehashshear muttar:
6.5: Ezehu ilan serak. kol sheeno ose ferot. rabbi meir omer, hakkol ilan serak, chutz min hazzayit vehatteena. rabbi yose omer, kol sheen kamohu notin sadot shelemot, hare ze ilan serak:
6.6: Piske aris, shemone ammot vaod. vechol middot sheamru chachamim bakkerem, en bahem vaod, chutz mippiske aris. elu hen piske aris, aris shecharav meemtzao venishtayyeru vo chamesh gefanim mikkan vechamesh gefanim mikkan. im yesh sham shemone ammot, lo yavi zera lesham. shemone ammot vaod, notnin lo chede avodato, vezorea et hammotar:
6.7: Aris shehu yotze min hakkotel mittoch hakkeren vechale, notnin lo avodato, vezorea et hammotar. rabbi yose omer, im en sham arba ammot, lo yavi zera lesham:
6.8: Hakkanim hayyotzim min hearis vechas alehen lefaskan, kenegdan muttar. asaan kede sheyyehallech alehen hechadash, asur:
6.9: Happerach hayyotze min hearis, roin oto keillu metuttelet teluya vo, kenegdo asur. vechen bedalit. hammoteach zemora meilan leilan, tachteha asur. sippekah bechevel o vegemi, tachat hassippuk muttar. asaah kede sheyyehallech alav hechadash, asur:

7.1: Hammavrich et haggefen baaretz, im en afar al gabbah shelosha tefachim, lo yavi zera aleha, afillu hivrichah bidlaat o vesilon. hivrichah besela, af al pi sheen afar al gabbah ella shalosh etzbaot, muttar lehavi zera aleha. haarkubba shebbaggefen, en moddin lah ella min haikkar hashsheni:
7.2: Hammavrich shalosh gefanim veikkarehem nirim, rabbi eliezer bar tzadok omer, im yesh benehem mearba ammot vead shemone, hare ellu mitztarfot. veim lav, enan mitztarfot. gefen sheyyavsha, asura veenah mekaddeshet. rabbi meir omer, af tzemer gefen asur veeno mekaddesh. rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer mishshemo, af al gabbe haggefen asur veeno mekaddesh:
7.3: Ellu osrin velo mekaddeshin. motar charban hakkerem, motar mechol hakkerem, motar piske aris, motar appifyarot. aval tachat haggefen, vaavodat haggefen, vearba ammot shebbakkerem, hare ellu mitkaddeshot:
7.4: Hamesakkech et gafno al gabbe tevuato shel chavero, hare ze kiddesh, vechayyav beacharayuto. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim, en adam mekaddesh davar sheeno shello:
7.5: Amar rabbi yose, maase beechad shezzara et karmo bashsheviit, uva maase lifne rabbi akiva, veamar, en adam mekaddesh davar sheeno shello:
7.6: Haannas shezzara et hakkerem veyatza millefanav, kotzro afillu vammoed. ad kamma hu noten lappoalim, ad shelish. yater mikkan, kotzer kedarko veholech afillu leachar hammoed. meematay hu nikra annas, mishsheyyishka:
7.7: Haruach sheilala et haggefanim al gabbe tevua, yigdor miyyad. im ero ones, muttar. tevuato shehayta nota tachat haggefen, vechen beyarak, machazir veeno mekaddesh. meematay tevua mitkaddeshet, mishshettashrish. vaanavim, mishsheyyeasu kefol hallavan. tevua sheyyavsha kol tzarkah, vaanavim shebbashlu kol tzarkan, en mitkaddeshot:
7.8: Atzitz nakuv mekaddesh bakkerem, vesheeno nakuv eno mekaddesh. verabbi shimon omer, ze veze osrin velo mekaddeshin. hammaavir atzitz nakuv bakkerem, im hosif bematayim, asur:

8.1: Kile hakkerem asurin millizroa, umillekayyem, vaasurin bahanaa. kile zeraim, asurim millizroa umillekayyem, umuttarin baachila, vechol shekken bahanaa. kile vegadim muttarin bechol davar, veenan asurin ella millilbosh. kile vehema muttarim legaddel ulekayyem, veenan asurim ella milleharbia. kile vehema asurim ze vaze:
8.2: Behema im behema vechayya im chayya, behema im chayya vechayya im behema, temea im temea utehora im tehora, temea im tehora utehora im temea, asurin lacharosh velimshoch ulehanhig:
8.3: Hammanhig sofeg et haarbaim, vehayyoshev bakkaron sofeg et haarbaim. rabbi meir poter. vehashshelishit shehi keshura lartzuot, asura:
8.4: En koshrin et hassus lo letzidde hakkaron velo leachar hakkaron, velo et halluvdekim ligmallim. rabbi yehuda omer, kol hannoladim min hassus, af al pi sheavihen chamor, muttarin ze im ze. vechen hannoladim min hachamor, af al pi sheavihem sus, muttarin ze im ze. aval hannoladim min hassus im hannoladim mechamor, asurim ze im ze:
8.5: Happerutiyyot asurot, veharammach muttar. veadne hassade, chayya. rabbi yose omer, metammeot baohel kaadam. hakkuppad vechuldat hassenayim, chayya. chuldat hassenayim, rabbi yose omer, bet shammay omrim, metamme chazzayit bemassa, vechaadasha bemagga:
8.6: Shor bar, min behema. verabbi yose omer, min chayya. kelev, min chayya. rabbi meir omer, min behema. chazir, min behema. arod, min chayya. happil vehakkof, min chayya. veadam muttar im kullam limshoch velacharosh ulehanhig:

9.1: En asur mishshum kilayim ella tzemer ufishtim. veeno mittamme vingaim ella tzemer ufishtim. en hakkohanim lovshin leshammesh bevet hammikdash ella tzemer ufishtim. tzemer gemallim vetzemer rechelim shetterafan ze vaze, im rov min haggemallim, muttar, veim rov min harchelim, asur. mechetza lemechetza, asur. vechen happishtan vehakkanbos shetterafan ze vaze:
9.2: Hashshirayim vehakkalach en bahem mishshum kilayim, aval asurim mippene marit haayin. hakkarim vehakkesatot en bahem mishshum kilayim, uvilvad shello yihye vesaro nogea bahen. en aray lechilayim. velo yilbash kilayim afillu al gabbe asara, afillu lignov et hammeches:
9.3: Mitpechot hayyadayim, mitpechot hassefarim, mitpechot hassappag, en bahem mishshum kilayim. rabbi elazar oser. umitpechot hassapparim, asurot mishshum kilayim:
9.4: Tachriche hammet umardaat shel chamor, en bahem mishshum kilayim. lo yitten hammardaat al ketefo, afillu lehotzi aleha zevel:
9.5: Mochre chesut mochrin kedarkan, uvilvad shello yitkavvenu bachamma mippene hachamma, uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim. vehatztzenuim mafshilin bemakkel laachorehem:
9.6: Tofre chesut tofrin kedarkan, uvilvad shello yitkavvenu bachamma mippene hachamma, uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim. vehatztzenuim tofrim baaretz:
9.7: Habbarsin vehabbardesin vehaddalmetikyon uminalot happinnon, lo yilbash bahen ad sheyyivdok. rabbi yose omer, habbaim mechof hayyam umimmedinat hayyam enan tzerichin bedika, mippene shechezkatan bakkanbos. uminal shel zered en bo mishshum kilayim:
9.8: En asur mishshum kilayim ella tavuy vearug, shenneemar (Devarim 22) lo tilbash shaatnez, davar shehu shua tavuy vanuz. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, naloz umelliz hu et aviv shebbashshamayim alav:
9.9: Hallevadim asurim, mippene shehem shuim. piv shel tzemer beshel pishtan asur, mippene shehem chozrin kaarig. rabbi yose omer, meshichot shel argaman asurot, mippene shehu molel ad shello kosher. lo yikshor seret shel tzemer beshel pishtan lachgor bo et matnav, af al pi shehartzua vaemtza:
9.10: Otot haggardin veotot hakkovsim, asurot mishshum kilayim. hattochef techifa achat, enah chibbur, veen bah mishshum kilayim, vehashshomtah beshabbat, patur. asa shene rasheha letzad echad, chibbur, veyesh bah mishshum kilayim, vehashshomtah beshabbat, chayyav. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyeshallesh. hassak vehakkuppa mitztarfin lechilayim:
